test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

The recommendations of the committee / regarding changes in the eligibility criteria / was not accept.

options.text: regarding changes in the eligibility criteria

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the verb form in part D: "was not accept."
 
• The correct verb form should be "accepted" instead of "accept," as the sentence requires the past tense of the verb.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part D** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The recommendations of the committee regarding changes in the eligibility criteria were not accepted."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "The recommendations of the committee"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "regarding changes in the eligibility criteria"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "were not"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "accept"** – The verb form should be "accepted" in the past tense to match the rest of the sentence.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part D.
